title: CREED OS Release Verification Evidence Manifest
description: Machine-readable verification record for Release Candidate 3 (v1.0.0-rc3) gate execution

gates.name: Reproducible Build & Release Provenance
gates.commandOrTestId: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run check && pnpm test && pnpm run lint:css && pnpm run design:audit:test && pnpm run design:audit && pnpm run check:licenses && pnpm run build
gates.invalidationReason: Any commit modifying application source code, workspace packages, dependencies, or build configurations invalidates Gate 1.

gates.name: Production Authentication, Authorization & DPDP Consent Lifecycle
gates.commandOrTestId: SEC-01 through SEC-18 attack suite against production preview
gates.invalidationReason: Any commit touching server auth hooks, session validation, consent verification routes, or report streaming invalidates Gate 2.

gates.name: Supabase/PostgreSQL RLS & Tenant Isolation
gates.commandOrTestId: RLS-01 through RLS-11 SQL harness + PostgREST HTTP test suite
gates.invalidationReason: Any commit modifying PostgreSQL schemas, RLS policies, migrations, or database functions invalidates Gate 3.

gates.name: Psychometric Confidentiality, AI Universal Trust & Evidence Integrity
gates.commandOrTestId: PSY-01 through PSY-04 network serialization AST scan, Socratic Universal Trust protocol (12 tests), and Evidence graph projection (7 tests)
gates.invalidationReason: Any commit modifying CAT/IRT algorithms, session response serialization, Socratic AI trust, or evidence pipelines invalidates Gate 4.

gates.name: Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), Responsive UX & WAY 2.1 Compliance
gates.commandOrTestId: pnpm run design:audit (12 laws) + pnpm run design:audit:test (9/9 negative checks caught)
gates.invalidationReason: Any commit modifying UI components, CSS stylesheets, layout templates, or design audit scripts invalidates Gate 5.

gates.name: Dependency Supply Chain, Clean-Room Verification & Licensing Evidence
gates.invalidationReason: Any change to package manifests, scripts, or lockfiles invalidates Gate 6.

gates.name: CI Completeness & Multi-Run Test Reliability
gates.commandOrTestId: pnpm test (91/91 passed across domain, ai, assessment) + Playwright regression (104/104 passed)
gates.invalidationReason: Any change to GitHub workflow definitions, Playwright configs, or E2E tests invalidates Gate 7.

gates.name: Operational Readiness, Resilience & Sandbox Security
gates.commandOrTestId: DRILL-01 through DRILL-05 rehearsals + Pyodide WebWorker sandbox security suite
gates.invalidationReason: Any change to Web Workers, Pyodide scripts, database backup configs, or background jobs invalidates Gate 9.

gates.name: Release Governance & Accountable Sign-Off
gates.commandOrTestId: Formal evaluation of release candidate against Risk Register
gates.invalidationReason: Any invalidation of G1–G7 or G9 automatically invalidates Gate 8.
